description: NORO-REBASE-01 canary: the spirit_cruise_3000 12-day cell of noro_rebase_01 at seeds 8105-8124 (20 seeds). Highest pre-fix posting cell in the FLUSH-S4 `off` baseline (20 per 1,000 at 12d), so it is the cell most likely to expose a posting-regime change and the cheapest strong read on whether post-724 posting still fires. Gate before the array: pipeline end-to-end (run -> zip -> summary.json -> score_anchors) must parse clean and the posting field must be populated. Read out before the 16-run array is submitted.

fl_spr_12d.description: Declared-complement posting cell on the post-#724 engine: this hull's own layout and complement under the shipped kernel, the reportable boarding rung, sanitary_visit_mode dwell_weighted, flush_aerosol_fraction off and the cabin-compartment/pool-transport settings of the FLUSH-S4 `off` arm it replays voyage-for-voyage at paired seeds 8105/8106. Posting frequency and attack rate are readable because the complement is the hull's own; the cabin-fomite channel and crew watch schedules land on the engine defaults, untouched by this cell's overrides.
